  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `is_deleted` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

sub_recruiters.createSql:
CREATE TABLE `sub_recruiters` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `main_recruiter_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `sub_recruiter_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `company_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `designation` varchar(100) DEFAULT 'Recruiter',
  `role_preset` enum('team_admin','recruiter','sourcer','custom') DEFAULT 'recruiter',
  `permissions` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`permissions`)),
  `status` enum('active','suspended') DEFAULT 'active',
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_main` (`main_recruiter_id`),
  KEY `idx_sub` (`sub_recruiter_id`),
  KEY `idx_company` (`company_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=2 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

subscription_history.createSql:
CREATE TABLE `subscription_history` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `subscription_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `recruiter_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `old_plan_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `new_plan_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `change_type` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `effective_type` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'immediately',
  `previous_expiry` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `new_expiry` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `reason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `changed_by_admin_id` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_recruiter_history` (`recruiter_id`),
  KEY `idx_sub_history` (`subscription_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=7 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

subscription_plans.createSql:
CREATE TABLE `subscription_plans` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `plan_type` enum('monthly','yearly','custom') DEFAULT 'monthly',
  `price` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `currency` varchar(10) DEFAULT 'INR',
  `validity_days` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
  `job_post_limit` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
  `active_job_limit` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,
  `featured_job_limit` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `urgent_job_limit` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `sub_recruiter_limit` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `resume_view_limit` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 50,
  `resume_download_limit` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
  `candidate_search` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0,
  `candidate_contact` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0,
  `resume_database` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0,
  `interview_management` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 1,
  `application_management` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 1,
  `shortlisting` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 1,
  `company_profile` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 1,
  `recruiter_dashboard` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 1,
  `email_notifications` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 1,
  `company_branding` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0,
  `status` enum('active','inactive') DEFAULT 'active',
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `slug` (`slug`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=4 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

subscription_usage.createSql:
CREATE TABLE `subscription_usage` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `subscription_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `recruiter_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `billing_period_start` datetime NOT NULL,
  `billing_period_end` datetime NOT NULL,
  `job_posts_used` int(11) DEFAULT 0,
  `resume_views_used` int(11) DEFAULT 0,
  `resume_downloads_used` int(11) DEFAULT 0,
  `featured_jobs_used` int(11) DEFAULT 0,
  `urgent_jobs_used` int(11) DEFAULT 0,
  `candidate_contacts_used` int(11) DEFAULT 0,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_subscription_recruiter` (`subscription_id`,`recruiter_id`),
  KEY `idx_billing_period` (`billing_period_start`,`billing_period_end`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=3 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

user_address.createSql:
CREATE TABLE `user_address` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `address1` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `city` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `state` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `country` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pincode` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_date` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=3 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

user_daily_usage.createSql:
CREATE TABLE `user_daily_usage` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `usage_date` date NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `unique_user_date` (`user_id`,`usage_date`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=136 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

user_education.createSql:
CREATE TABLE `user_education` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `qualification` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `course` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `specialization` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `college` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `start_date` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `end_date` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `course_type` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `percentage` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cgpa` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `roll_number` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lateral_entry` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0,
  `is_deleted` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_user_edu_user_del` (`user_id`,`is_deleted`),
  KEY `idx_user_edu_course` (`course`(100)),
  KEY `idx_user_edu_qual` (`qualification`(50))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=5 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

user_professional.createSql:
CREATE TABLE `user_professional` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `job_title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `company_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `designation` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `start_date` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `end_date` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `currently_working` tinyint(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `skills` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_deleted` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_user_prof_user_del` (`user_id`,`is_deleted`),
  KEY `idx_user_prof_curr` (`user_id`,`currently_working`,`is_deleted`),
  KEY `idx_user_prof_title` (`job_title`(100)),
  KEY `idx_user_prof_comp` (`company_name`(100)),
  KEY `idx_user_prof_desig` (`designation`(100))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=9 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

user_projects.createSql:
CREATE TABLE `user_projects` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `company_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `project_title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `project_type` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `start_date` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `end_date` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_deleted` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=2 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

user_saved_jobs.createSql:
CREATE TABLE `user_saved_jobs` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `job_post_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_date` datetime DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `unique_saved_job` (`user_id`,`job_post_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

user_social_links.createSql:
CREATE TABLE `user_social_links` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `linkedin` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `facebook` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `instagram` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `twitter` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `dribble` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `behance` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=7 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

user_type.createSql:
CREATE TABLE `user_type` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `is_deleted` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=5 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

users.createSql:
CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `role_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `first_name` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `last_name` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `phone_code` varchar(7) NOT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(13) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `gender` varchar(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_email_verified` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0',
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `profile_image` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `resume` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `about` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `skills` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `organization` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_type` varchar(30) DEFAULT NULL,
  `class` varchar(5) DEFAULT NULL,
  `course` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `start_year` year(4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `end_year` year(4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `experince_type` varchar(30) DEFAULT NULL,
  `total_years` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `total_months` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `location` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `organization_type_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_active` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'1',
  `created_date` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  `updated_date` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `fcm_token` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `banner_color` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `banner_image` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_active` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `languages` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `visa_status` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `preferred_job_type` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `dob` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `company_headcount` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `visibility_mode` varchar(20) DEFAULT 'Limited',
  `hidden_companies` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `allow_contact` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 1,
  `show_in_search` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_users_role_active` (`role_id`,`is_active`,`created_date`),
  KEY `idx_users_created_date` (`created_date`),
  KEY `idx_users_location` (`location`(50)),
  KEY `idx_users_gender` (`gender`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=586 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

venues.createSql:
CREATE TABLE `venues` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

work_location.createSql:

workplace_type.createSql:
